## ShopMate v4.2.6

- Pure WebAssembly SQLite (sql.js) engine with zero native compilation dependencies.
- Cross-platform native startup launchers for Windows (.bat), macOS (.command), and Linux (.sh).
- Lifetime Profit & Loss and Trading Logs reports.
- Unified General Income & Expense voucher management with auto-journal sync.
- High-performance minified and mangled production build.
